### A Time for Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/time-love
Passage: Song of Solomon 3:5
Points:
- Modern culture often idolizes romantic and sexual relationships as essential to living a fulfilled life, an attitude sometimes reflected in churches.
- Overemphasizing marriage can pressure singles into unwise attachments or cause them to question their personal worth.
- Scripture counsels believers not to awaken love before the right time, meaning genuine affection should unfold naturally rather than by force.
- Letting love develop patiently prepares couples for the realistic trials and unmet longings common even to good relationships.
- Ultimate value and peace rest in the Lord's love rather than marital status, whether one is currently single or facing hardship in marriage.

### How to Find the One Who Your Soul Loves
Author: Rhonda Stoppe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/family/marriage/how-to-find-the-one-who-your-soul-loves.html
Passage: Song of Solomon 3:4
Points:
- God designed deep marital unity not merely for personal happiness, but to draw others to Christ and fulfill Kingdom purposes.
- Discerning a future spouse requires saturating one's mind with God's truth rather than depending on fickle emotions.
- True spiritual oneness requires being equally yoked with a believer indwelt by the Holy Spirit.
- Maintaining personal purity keeps believers spiritually sensitive to God's leading when seeking a spouse.
- Singles should observe character and spiritual fruit, serve Christ actively, and invite trusted godly counselors into their dating decisions.
